title: Round622: Rust simulator parity and closed-sheet information boundary
status: sampled parity and move-secrecy checks passed; backend not integrated

request_filter: Drop switch actions when the acting player's request marks that active slot trapped or maybeTrapped.
Drop moves marked disabled in the acting player's request.
differential_replay.comparison: Normalized player-view logs, turn count, terminal flag, and winner.
differential_replay.limits: Random legal-choice trajectories only. This does not certify all mechanics, state combinations, or all legal actions. The request filter is conservative for maybeTrapped slots.

hidden_information_audit.postselection_phase: After lead selection, before turn-one choices.
hidden_information_audit.result: Tracker.view was byte-for-byte identical under hidden-set mutations in all tested views.
hidden_information_audit.critical_finding: Battle.projection() contains opponent hidden moves, held items, abilities, and stats. Never pass this engine snapshot to a policy or player-view feature encoder. Use Tracker.view, the acting player request, and the player-visible protocol stream.
hidden_information_audit.limits: These are smoke checks on a 70-team pool and two early-game phases; every hidden field, world-sampling path, and midgame reveal still requires audit.

reproduction.dependencies: ninjask==0.4.0; local Showdown Node dependencies for parity replay
reproduction.privacy_result: 70/70 preselection hidden-set mutations and 70/70 postselection move mutations left Tracker.view byte-for-byte unchanged.

next: Audit other hidden fields and midgame reveals, then integrate an optional request-constrained Ninjask sampling backend behind Showdown differential checks. Reconsider JAX only after end-to-end CPU backend profiling.
